name: Pokemon Stadium 2 Overworld Models - Gold/Silver (Gen 2)
description: Standalone Gold/Silver Gen-2 voxel + Stadium 2 mod. v0.2.11 makes overworld capture a pre-contact aim-and-throw action: press controller R3 or right mouse while aiming at a visible wild Pokemon, with Gold input.step polling so it works while standing still. It also replaces the scrambled Poké Ball atlas mapping with a corrected UV sphere/material and makes Lugia fail safely to Gold's texture-correct sprite instead of broken Stadium 2 chunks. Retains world-space Stadium-style move FX, clean 3D send-out, connected-map streaming, F6/right-stick cameras, 32-tile round-tree apron, and crash-safe live battles.
